text:
Tasha: FYI I'm heading out in ~10m, leaving a quick handoff here. Current state: INC-4212 (model-serving 503s). We hit a spike ~25m ago, still happening but partially mitigated by traffic shaping.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-4212 created by monitoring (rate > 80% errors on /v1/generate) — severity: P2 — assigned: devon.

Tasha: Primary for the next 4h is Devon (confirmed), Samir is secondary. If Devon doesn't ack within 5m of a page escalate per the matrix below.

Devon: acked. I'm online. Quick notes: error rate correlates with recent model rollout (model:v3-q4). I rolled a hotfix to scale workers x2 but KV cache pressure still high.

Samir: noted. If the error rate crosses 50% for >3 minutes we should flip to model:v2-stable and backfill cache. I can do the rollback if Devon is paged.

Tasha: Coverage gaps: after 00:00 UTC we lose APAC onsite coverage; Alisa is the infra oncall for the 00:00-04:00 window (she's on standby). If this becomes a cross-region degradation, page Alisa directly.

Devon: runbook pointers — follow runbook: https://confluence.redwood/inference/runbooks/model-serving-503 (steps 1-6). Quick snippets:
```
# check pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-serving
# tail problematic pod logs
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/model-serving -c runtime --since=10m
```

Devon: mitigation plan I will attempt: 1) scale replica count +2; 2) if no improvement in 3m, rollback to v2. Samir will prepare rollback command.

Samir: rollback command ready: `kubectl set image deployment/model-serving model-container=registry/redwood/model:v2-stable --record` — will run on Devon's sign-off.

Tasha: Paging/escalation rules (cheat sheet):
- Page primary (Devon) first. If no ack in 5m, pager escalates to secondary (Samir).
- If incident severity becomes P1 (criteria: >3 customer-facing outages or global latency >2x across regions), page `eng-sre-lead` and `pagerduty:p1-escalation` immediately.
- If customer-impacting (billing-affecting or data-loss) notify CS lead (@maya-cs) and exec oncall.
- Use the "page now" action in PagerDuty for P1; for P2 prefer phone escalation only after 15m of no progress.

pagerduty-bot: Page sent to Devon (device: mobile).

Devon: I see the page, scaling now. I'll monitor for the next 3m and report back.

Tasha: Customer impact assessment: so far internal alerts + a couple of error reports from two customers (low traffic customers). Not yet widespread. Marking impact: limited -> escalate to P1 if we see >5% of total qps failing for 10m.

Devon: scale success — replica count increased, error rate dropped from 78% -> 35% in 90s. Still higher than baseline. Next: decide rollback if not <10% in 3m.

Samir: preparing rollback window, will coordinate on slack confirm. If we do rollback, follow the post-rollback smoke check in runbook: call /health and sample generation for 5 tokens to confirm KV cache warmup.

Tasha: handoff checklist for leaving:
- Primary/secondary set (Devon/Samir) ✅
- Runbook link pinned ✅
- Customer-impact threshold defined ✅
- Infra standby (Alisa) notified for midnight window ✅

Alisa: saw the note, will standby for cross-region escalation. If you flip to P1 tag `@alisa` and I'll join.

Devon: 3m timer started. Will post status at +3m and +10m or when we rollback.

oncall-bot: Reminder — please update the incident channel (incidents) with customer-facing summary before handoff ends.

Tasha: leaving now. If anything critical, page both Devon and Samir. My emergency contact is in PagerDuty. Back tomorrow morning. :wave:

Devon: copying timeline into incidents channel, will update on progress.

(last) Devon: +3m update — errors at 18% now, trending down. No rollback required at this time. Keeping as P2. If trend reverses, will escalate.

Samir: standing by.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-4212 updated: severity remains P2 — last updated by Devon.
